Lemma
[Associativity of space-time convolution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0294 ↗ def:chow-iii-space-time-convolution 1. ch24:24.15\group Convolution Series

Whenever the relevant integrals are defined, space-time convolution is associative.
Proof

\sketch Fubini’s theorem identifies both bracketings with the integral over $v<\rho <\sigma <\tau $, after relabeling the two intermediate points.
